about.title: The biggest competition for girls
about.description: <pink>Women’s Hack Day</pink> is an annual <pink>3-round team competition</pink>, where female high school, college, and university students can challenge themselves in various areas of software engineering and development. In teams of 3-4, participants will work together on tasks in <pink>mathematics, competitive programming, and product design</pink>.
about.organizers: The organizer is the NU ACM-W Student Chapter — the first and only branch of ACM-Women in Kazakhstan and Central Asia. Our mission is to support women in STEM fields, especially in IT, through initiatives that foster social, professional, and technical growth.

whatIs.a: Women’s Hack Day (WHD) is an annual three-round team competition in mathematics, competitive programming, and product design - the biggest competition for girls who dream of conquering the world of IT.

organizers.q: Who are the organisers of WHD?
organizers.a: The organizer is the NU ACM-W Student Chapter - the first and only branch of ACM-Women in Kazakhstan and Central Asia. Our mission is to support women in STEM fields, especially in IT, through initiatives that foster social, professional, and technical growth.

otherEvents.q: Are there any other events for girls?
otherEvents.a: Yes! ACM-W annually organizes events for girls such as CodeW - an individual competitive programming contest, and Code Girl Summer - a two-week web development camp. You can find more details and information on our Telegram and Instagram pages.

whoCanParticipate.a: Girls who are high school, college, and university students. Participation is in teams of 3-4 people.

professional.q: Do I need to be a professional?
professional.a: No, everyone interested in IT is welcome to participate.

noTeam.q: What if I don't have a team?
noTeam.a: You can find teammates in our <link href="https://t.me/WHD_chat">Telegram chat</link>.

howToParticipate.a: Form a team of 3-4 people, register, and come to Nazarbayev University on October 25, 2025. Please note that the registration form should be completed by one representative of the team. Registration deadline: October 22, 2025.

online.a: No, Women’s Hack Day 2025 will be held offline at Nazarbayev University, Astana, Kazakhstan.

certificates.q: Will participants receive certificates or prizes?
certificates.a: Yes, every participant will receive a certificate of participation. Winners will get cash prizes and merch, plus there will be welcome packages for the first 110 participants and a coffee break for everyone. Additionally, there are 3 spots for online career coaching with Freedom Broker's Director of Data and Analytics, Ekaterina Strukova.

noAnswer.q: I didn't find an answer to my question. What should I do?
noAnswer.a: Join our <link href="https://t.me/WHD_chat">Telegram chat</link> and ask your questions there, or contact us via email: <link href="https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/?fs=1&to=acm_w@nu.edu.kz&su&body&tf=cm">acm_w@nu.edu.kz.</link>
